_meta.description: Externalized configuration for the Security Operations Discovery Pack: pack version, SecOps terminology set, detector thresholds, and scorer calibration. Loaded from this file so a config change alters pack behaviour with no code deploy — the same externalized mechanism the Cloud-Operations pack (MSP-B6) established. Detector and scorer LOGIC is not here (T2/T6) — only the values those tasks read.
_meta.note: Editing a value below changes behaviour on the next run; no restart or code change required. Bump packVersion (mirrored in pack_config.py) on any detector/scorer/corroboration change.

terminology._note: The SecOps vocabulary this pack speaks in findings, roadmap, and executive report — the same externalized re-labelling mechanism the lending and cloud-ops packs use. glossary defines each canonical SecOps term (MSP-B12 §2); language_map re-labels generic AgentIQ / service-management vocabulary into SecOps language for terminology-aware rendering (later tasks).

glossary.remediation: The work of resolving a vulnerability or security finding — the SecOps unit of effort, measured as median time-in-state per remediation cycle.
glossary.scan_cycle: One recurring vulnerability-scan-to-remediation loop over the estate; findings count and characterise effort per scan cycle rather than per host.
glossary.deferral: A postponed or risk-accepted remediation, tracked by justification class — a compliance-pressure signal a federal MSP answers for every month.
glossary.sla: The remediation service-level agreement a queue is measured against; ageing against an SLA baseline is the queue-pressure signal.
glossary.triage: Classification and initial disposition of a security incident (SIR); high-volume same-classification triage in short time is the enrichment-agent candidate.
glossary.severity_band: The banded severity of a vulnerability class or incident (critical / high / medium / low / informational) used to weight workload so critical-band toil ranks above informational-band toil at equal effort.
glossary.security_queue: A security or remediation work queue (an assignment group's backlog), the aggregation unit for ageing and workload — never an individual analyst.
glossary.ci_class: A class of configuration item (a shared infrastructure component type) that vulnerability workload traces to via dependency edges — the concentration unit, never an individual host.

thresholds._note: Detector firing boundaries. Read by the detectors built in MSP-B12 T2 (Section 1); no detector logic lives here. One block per Section-1 detector.

calibration._note: SecOps impact scorer calibration. Read by the scorer built in MSP-B12 T6; no scorer logic lives here. impact_weights are relative ranking weights (effort concentration x recurrence stability x breadth of services relieved); severity_band carries the per-band weighting so critical-band toil ranks above informational-band toil at equal effort (T6 AC6 — a value change alters ranked order with no code deploy); confidence describes the honest-confidence caps enforced at the pack boundary.

severity_band._note: Severity-band weighting (T6 AC6). Higher weight ranks that band's toil above a lower band's at equal effort. Config, not code — editing these re-ranks findings with no code deploy.
